name: Bus Stop
description:
Concentration, up to 1 Round.

You slam your Orb to the ground and hold it there as it begins to pulsate with energy.

At the start of your next turn, if you have maintained Concentration and used no other Abilities, the Orb releases all stored MP in a blast of energy, sparing only creatures touching it.

Each creature within the Orb's range that is not touching it rolls Dexterity against the Orb's Difficulty. The Orb deals its damage to each creature that fails. Add +1d for each 1 MP released and for each creature other than you that is touching the Orb. Each creature that passes takes half damage.
